article.title: A 3D in vitro model for studying human implantation and implantation failure
article.source_review_depth: PubMed abstract and publisher-hosted supplemental workbook only; full article not reviewed

reported_scope.model_question: Study human embryo-endometrium interaction and recurrent implantation failure using a three-dimensional in-chip model.
abstract_claims: The abstract reports reduced blastoid implantation capability with recurrent-implantation-failure-derived endometrioids relative to fertile controls.
The abstract reports candidates identified by a compound screen.

supplement_review.qualification: The workbook's group counts describe its clinical/endometrial sample-characteristics table and are not treated as implantation-assay sample sizes. Participant-level values were not transcribed; the workbook does not provide assay outcome rows or a sample-to-assay crosswalk.

data_routes.search_scope_qualification: Exact-term results are bounded to the queried BioStudies and GEO endpoints; they do not prove that data are absent from other repositories or access routes.

observation_intake.reason_not_promoted: The abstract claims are qualitative at the inspected depth. Assay outcome values, operational endpoint definition, timepoint, exact denominator and sample-to-assay linkage were not verified.

feasibility_boundary.supports: Candidate evidence for an early human embryo-endometrium implantation research model.
